text:
maria: Quick sync — we need a proposal for per-route sampling that's deterministic for tail traces so customers can rely on consistent debugability across retries. current random head sampling is breaking some billing + SLO investigations. :raising_hand:
raj: Agree. Problem is we also need to keep cost under control for high-volume routes. Suggest deterministic hashing on trace_id + route_id to ensure stickiness, then a tail-sampler that promotes traces with rare error spans.
sonny: Hash + priority map sounds decent. How do we signal rare errors? We could add a boolean span attribute like telemetry.error_flag or rely on status_code >=500 plus exception events. The tail sampler needs to ingest a small subset of spans to decide, which reintroduces cost.
kat: UX ask — console should let customers set sampling_policies per-route and per-tier (gold/silver/free) and opt into "full retention on errors". Would be nice to preview estimated ingest cost when they change policy.
raj: Implementation sketch: 1) OTLP exporter sends lightweight headers for all spans (trace_id, route_id, status). 2) Ingest layer does cheap deterministic selection for head sampling to control token count. 3) For tail decisions, keep a short rolling window per-trace in redis to see if any span has error_flag or high-latency tags. If so, mark trace for full-span export to S3/long-term storage and to APM index.
sonny: That rolling-window idea is sensible. Concern: backend memory explosion for large number of in-flight traces from top customers. Need TTLs and backpressure. Also consider sampling budget per-tenant: once budget exhausted, degrade to meta-only (no full spans).
maria: Also think about downstream exporters — we should classify exporters as "high-fidelity" (indexing + full spans) vs "low-fidelity" (aggregates only). The ingestion pipeline can route full-span exports to high-fidelity exporters only when a trace is promoted.
kat: Small config example for console (proposal):
```yaml
sampling_policy:
  default_rate: 0.01
  per_route_overrides:
    /api/generate: 0.05
  per_tier:
    gold: 0.1
  tail_promotion:
    enabled: true
    criteria:
      - span.attribute: exception
      - span.status_code_gte: 500
    lookback_seconds: 30
  budget_per_tenant_per_hour: 1000
```
raj: We should add a deterministic key for hashing: concat(route_id, tenant_id, trace_id_prefix) so quotas and stickiness are stable across retries. Also add a fallback flow that sends a small envelope (trace metadata + counters) if we can't afford full spans.
sonny: Can we prototype with a controlled rollout? telemetry-bot: deploy plan queued: feature-flag "det-tail-proto" targeting 10% of tenants, route whitelist: [/api/generate, /api/chat].
maria: Cool. Action items: raj to draft proto impl + cost model, sonny to build TTL + budget enforcement, kat to mock console preview and create a UX ticket. We'll sync in two days. :thumbsup:
